title: xeraea pilosa
intro: Xeraea pilosa, commonly known as Huachuma or Andean mint, is a plant native to the Andean region of South America. It has been used traditionally for its medicinal properties and is valued for its ability to promote relaxation, reduce stress, and improve mental clarity. The health benefits of Xeraea pilosa include its potential to lower blood pressure, reduce anxiety, and improve sleep quality, attributed to its therapeutic actions of sedation, anti-anxiety, and anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents of Xeraea pilosa include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its therapeutic actions.
